semantics.clock: All sequential logic updates on the positive edge of clk, as stated in the original problem.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset sets q to zero on a positive edge, regardless of slowena.
semantics.enabled: On a positive edge with reset low and slowena high, advance the decade count by one; 9 advances to 0.
semantics.paused: On a positive edge with reset low and slowena low, retain q.
semantics.between_edges: Input changes alone do not update q.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value is specified; no initialization is added. Functional counting checks begin after synchronous reset.

verification.oracle: Independent integer model derived from original reset, enable and decade sequence requirements.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs at falling edges; check stability before rising edge and sample after rising-edge nonblocking assignments settle.
verification.directed: Synchronous reset between edges, reset priority for both enable values, full cycles, hold at 0 and 9, resume and rollover.
verification.additional: Deterministic mixed enable/reset sequence, bounded timeout, fatal mismatches, explicit PASS only at completion.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up q is unspecified; verification imposes no value before the first reset edge.
Behavior for unreachable count values 10 through 15 and unknown inputs is unspecified; no forced-state or unknown-input oracle is imposed.
